verdict.rationale: The evidence shows LocalAI auto-detects GPU capability and ships a CPU path, and can add distributed GPU worker nodes, but nothing describes partial/layer-based GPU offload for a single model exceeding VRAM (e.g., n_gpu_layers or similar tuning) or any guidance on running larger-than-VRAM models via combined CPU+GPU. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or setting for hybrid CPU+GPU layer offload, guidance on tuning offload ratio, or benchmarks showing oversized-model support.
